en.title: **Founder** · **Product Engineer** · **Technical Lead**
en.text:
Founded GAMAN AI Corporation and built FadeSlot end-to-end, a multi-tenant SaaS platform for appointment-driven businesses, live in production with real customers and active subscription revenue.

  • Designed and shipped a complete SaaS architecture: multi-tenant data model, tenant isolation, RBAC, and per-business configuration.
  • Built the product on Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS: booking engine, POS, inventory, reviews, and analytics.
  • Integrated Stripe for subscription billing: plans, trials, upgrades, and revenue analytics.
  • Owned AWS infrastructure end-to-end: S3 media, scalable Postgres, deployment, and scaling.
  • Shipped a bilingual (EN/ES), mobile-first product with automated notifications and operational dashboards.

es.title: **Founder** · **Product Engineer** · **Technical Lead**
es.text:
Fundé GAMAN AI Corporation y construí FadeSlot end-to-end, una plataforma SaaS multi-tenant para negocios basados en citas, en producción con clientes reales e ingresos activos por suscripción.

  • Diseñé y lancé una arquitectura SaaS completa: modelo multi-tenant, aislamiento por tenant, RBAC y configuración por negocio.
  • Construí el producto sobre Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL y AWS: motor de reservas, POS, inventario, reseñas y analítica.
  • Integré Stripe para facturación por suscripción: planes, trials, upgrades y analítica de ingresos.
  • Operé la infraestructura AWS end-to-end: S3 para media, Postgres escalable, despliegue y escalado.
  • Lancé un producto bilingüe (EN/ES) mobile-first con notificaciones automatizadas y dashboards operativos.

fr.title: **Founder** · **Product Engineer** · **Technical Lead**
fr.text:
J'ai fondé GAMAN AI Corporation et construit FadeSlot de bout en bout, une plateforme SaaS multi-tenant pour les entreprises basées sur le rendez-vous, en production avec de vrais clients et un revenu d'abonnement actif.

  • Conception et livraison d'une architecture SaaS complète: modèle multi-tenant, isolation par tenant, RBAC et configuration par entreprise.
  • Construction du produit sur Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL et AWS: moteur de réservation, POS, inventaire, avis et analytics.
  • Intégration de Stripe pour les abonnements: plans, essais, upgrades et analytics de revenus.
  • Ownership complet de l'infrastructure AWS: S3 média, Postgres scalable, déploiement et scaling.
  • Livraison d'un produit bilingue (EN/ES), mobile-first, avec notifications automatisées et dashboards opérationnels.

ko.title: **Founder** · **Product Engineer** · **Technical Lead**
ko.text:
GAMAN AI Corporation을 창업하고 FadeSlot을 엔드투엔드로 구축한, 예약 기반 비즈니스를 위한 멀티 테넌트 SaaS 플랫폼입니다. 실제 고객과 구독 매출과 함께 프로덕션에서 운영 중입니다.

  • 멀티 테넌트 데이터 모델, 테넌트 격리, RBAC, 비즈니스별 구성을 갖춘 완전한 SaaS 아키텍처를 설계·출시.
  • Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS 기반의 예약 엔진, POS, 재고, 리뷰, 애널리틱스 제품 구축.
  • 플랜, 트라이얼, 업그레이드, 매출 분석을 포함한 Stripe 구독 빌링 통합.
  • S3 미디어, 확장 가능한 Postgres, 배포·스케일링까지 AWS 인프라 엔드투엔드 오너십.
  • 자동 알림과 운영 대시보드를 갖춘 이중 언어(EN/ES) 모바일 퍼스트 제품 출시.

en.title: **Fractional Product Engineer**
en.text:
Engaged with startups and agencies as a remote product engineer: shipping production features, building SaaS infrastructure, and accelerating product delivery across async teams.

  • Delivered production-ready features with Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL/Supabase, and AWS.
  • Built and refined dashboards, operational systems, APIs, auth flows, and deployment workflows.
  • Embedded into async remote teams with product-focused execution and clear, documented delivery.
  • Supported scalable SaaS frontends and backends: typed, tested, and production-ready.

es.title: **Fractional Product Engineer**
es.info: Remoto · Contrato · Trabajo con Startups y Agencias
es.text:
Colaboro con startups y agencias como product engineer remoto: lanzando features en producción, construyendo infraestructura SaaS y acelerando la entrega de producto en equipos async.

  • Entrega de features production-ready con Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL/Supabase y AWS.
  • Construcción y refinamiento de dashboards, sistemas operativos, APIs, flujos de auth y workflows de despliegue.
  • Embebido en equipos remotos async con ejecución enfocada en producto y entrega clara y documentada.
  • Soporte a frontends y backends SaaS escalables: tipados, testeados y listos para producción.

fr.title: **Fractional Product Engineer**
fr.text:
Missions avec startups et agences en tant que product engineer remote: livraison de fonctionnalités en production, construction d'infrastructure SaaS et accélération de la livraison produit en équipes async.

  • Livraison de fonctionnalités production-ready avec Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL/Supabase et AWS.
  • Construction et raffinement de dashboards, systèmes opérationnels, APIs, flux d'auth et workflows de déploiement.
  • Intégration dans des équipes remote async, avec exécution produit-first et livraison claire et documentée.
  • Support de frontends et backends SaaS scalables: typés, testés, production-ready.

ko.title: **Fractional Product Engineer**
ko.text:
스타트업과 에이전시와 함께 리모트 Product Engineer로 협업: 프로덕션 기능을 출시하고, SaaS 인프라를 구축하며, 비동기 팀의 제품 딜리버리를 가속화합니다.

  • Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL/Supabase, AWS로 프로덕션 레벨 기능을 제공.
  • 대시보드, 운영 시스템, API, 인증 플로우, 배포 워크플로우를 구축·개선.
  • 비동기 리모트 팀에 통합되어 제품 중심의 실행과 명확하고 문서화된 딜리버리 제공.
  • 타입 안전하고 테스트되어 프로덕션에 바로 적용 가능한 확장 가능한 SaaS 프론트엔드·백엔드 지원.

en.title: **Technical Lead** & **Software Architect**
en.text:
Led product engineering and architecture across the entire technology department: designing, building, and shipping operational SaaS platforms that ran the company's biomedical operations.

  • Defined system architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards across the company's software stack.
  • Architected and shipped BioSwift: a multi-module SaaS covering clients, equipment, inventory, and service orders.
  • Owned AWS infrastructure end-to-end (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53): deployment, scaling, and security.
  • Led a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and analysts under modern delivery practices.
  • Translated business needs into technical roadmaps, system designs, and shipped features.

es.title: **Technical Lead** & **Software Architect**
es.text:
Lideré la ingeniería de producto y la arquitectura de todo el departamento de tecnología: diseñando, construyendo y lanzando plataformas SaaS operativas que corrían las operaciones biomédicas de la compañía.

  • Definí la arquitectura de sistemas, estrategia técnica y estándares de ingeniería del stack de software.
  • Arquitecté y lancé BioSwift: un SaaS multi-módulo para clientes, equipos, inventario y órdenes de servicio.
  • Operé la infraestructura AWS end-to-end (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53): despliegue, escalado y seguridad.
  • Lideré un equipo cross-functional de ingenieros, diseñadores y analistas bajo prácticas modernas de delivery.
  • Traduje necesidades de negocio en roadmaps técnicos, diseños de sistema y features lanzados a producción.

fr.title: **Technical Lead** & **Software Architect**
fr.text:
J'ai dirigé l'ingénierie produit et l'architecture du département technologie: en concevant, construisant et livrant des plateformes SaaS opérationnelles qui faisaient tourner les opérations biomédicales de l'entreprise.

  • Définition de l'architecture système, de la stratégie technique et des standards d'ingénierie de la stack.
  • Architecte et livreur de BioSwift: un SaaS multi-module pour clients, équipements, inventaire et ordres de service.
  • Ownership complet de l'infrastructure AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53): déploiement, scaling, sécurité.
  • Direction d'une équipe cross-fonctionnelle d'ingénieurs, designers et analystes selon des pratiques modernes de delivery.
  • Traduction des besoins métier en roadmaps techniques, designs système et features livrées en production.

ko.title: **Technical Lead** & **Software Architect**
ko.text:
전체 기술 부서의 제품 엔지니어링과 아키텍처를 리드하며, 회사의 의료기기 운영을 구동하는 운영 SaaS 플랫폼을 설계·구축·출시했습니다.

  • 회사 소프트웨어 스택 전반의 시스템 아키텍처, 기술 전략, 엔지니어링 표준 정의.
  • 고객, 장비, 재고, 서비스 주문을 아우르는 멀티 모듈 SaaS BioSwift를 아키텍팅·출시.
  • 배포·스케일링·보안을 포함한 AWS 인프라(EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53) 엔드투엔드 오너십.
  • 현대적 딜리버리 프랙티스로 엔지니어, 디자이너, 애널리스트 크로스 펑셔널 팀을 리드.
  • 비즈니스 니즈를 기술 로드맵, 시스템 디자인, 그리고 실제 출시 기능으로 전환.

en.title: **Customer Care Advisor**
en.text: Customer support role: built foundational discipline in communication, prioritization, and operations later transferred to engineering and product work.

es.title: **Asesor de Atención al Cliente**
es.text: Rol de soporte al cliente: base sólida en comunicación, priorización y operaciones, posteriormente trasladada al trabajo de ingeniería y producto.

fr.title: **Conseiller en Service Client**
fr.text: Rôle de support client: base solide en communication, priorisation et opérations, transférée ensuite au travail d'ingénierie et de produit.

ko.title: **고객 케어 어드바이저**
ko.text: 고객 지원 역할: 커뮤니케이션, 우선순위 설정, 운영 디시플린의 기초를 다졌고 이후 엔지니어링과 제품 업무로 전환했습니다.
